comments.value: This is kind of a novelty; but a nice one regardless. Would be nice to walk between worlds and have people wish you a happy birthday.
Would definitely love to have that!

I think it may be nicer if your tag had like a cake with candles on it, so it will be there but not too noticeable, and also something you wouldn't be able to normally do in your activity settings, because technically we could just change our status if we wanted.
I feel adding a graphic with this on your own avatar would be better off doing yourself rather than implementing this an a fully fledged feature.
@{58c6b8f8227a56787575ebc0|full_name}: but what if user who use public avatars only? 🤔

@{5bb43306811720282b2cfbd3|full_name}: If it's important for the user to express themselves in the way they want, like having a birthday badge, then I think they should take the time to learn how to upload their own avatars and adding their own effects on them.
There are plenty of guides and tutorials out there and lots of people on the VRchat discord and other communities to help out if needed.
@{58c6b8f8227a56787575ebc0|full_name}: there should be some quest user who don't have a computer but never mind you will say it's their responsibility to buy a computer for uploading avatars 🙃
i mean by doing this you only want attention, i prefer just having fun with my friends because they mean a lot for me... more than some random dudes reading "it's my bday".
@{5bd385cc1d98246cdedebf61|full_name}: This is Dis**yland’s idea, btw if you can you do that on Twitter and Facebook, why not VRChat?
wow, everyone can have there birthday in 3 months each time. ill die fast

I think this would be really cool.... we do play something that is called VRChat Key word chat I have been playing almost every day since Sep 2 and to be honest have a good talk is hard to come by Add thing could bring more people together and have more interraction with people .... And if it is only a person screaming acrros the room happy birthday it might make people days better on a day where they might not have anyone

details:
Allow user to set birthday (with time zone)if they want, so when is birthday their name tag will show some kind of “Today is my birthday” badge.
Also unable to change birthday within 3 months etc.
title: Birthday badge on name tag
